comparison.method: 32x32 grayscale; color/contrast normalization; D4 transforms and periodic shifts; .985 automatic threshold plus manual identity/family rejection

provenance.semanticReview: Frozen1405 official-public-post reserve census, separate from fixed first100 pilot. All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

provenance.semanticReview: Frozen1405 official-public-post reserve census, separate from fixed first100 pilot. All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

provenance.semanticReview: Frozen1405 official-public-post reserve census, separate from fixed first100 pilot. All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.

provenance.legacyColorFilenameEvidence: Author *_COLOR original accompanied by separate NORM/DISP/OCC/ROUGH maps; normal public folder inspection saved in old-folder-filename-inspection.json
provenance.semanticReview: Frozen1405 official-public-post reserve census, separate from fixed first100 pilot. All1350 actual acquired original color maps were directly reviewed, with fixed baseline494 original-image canonical/variant/repair records, main123 material input, new119 pattern tiles, byte hashes, grayscale/color/contrast/D4/arbitrary-periodic-shift screening and targeted original crop comparisons. Source titles/material names alone do not determine duplication; common primitive grid/running-bond/stripe and low-information omitted-channel families are conservatively grouped. No resolutions, PBR channels, crops, colors or frame variants inflate count. Acquisition failures/non-material posts stay excluded in the census. All167 recovered legacy COLOR originals received the same direct-image and numerical review; original filenames, public folder/download provenance and full CC0 notice remain attached. This is not exhaustive pixel rendering of every pre-existing code item.
